title: New Tai(Khamti) Reader Basic Book
author: Chow Khouk Manpoong
description: Essential Tai Khamti literacy primer developed in Namsai and Chongkham, Arunachal Pradesh, introducing syllabic consonants, vowel diacritics, tonal contours, and basic reading vocabulary directly cognate with Tai Khamyang.
